supporting_observations.claim: The recurring outbound HTTPS activity is attributable in the endpoint network telemetry to C:\Program Files\PixelForge\pfupdater.exe, which was running as leo.martins.

The updater connected to updates.pixelforge-suite.com through the explicit proxy; observed attempts span 13:37:50 to 14:07:46 UTC at roughly five-minute intervals. The proxy records successful tunnels for the attempts at 13:37:50, 13:47:45, 13:53:13, 13:58:15, 14:02:29, and 14:07:46; the 13:42:31 attempt received status 407.
The observed process path, destination hostname, and approximate five-minute cadence match the organization's inventory description of the approved PixelForge updater.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT tunnels and metadata, not the encrypted update content; for example, the successful connection record at 14:07:46 reports the hostname, status, byte counts, and duration but not payload contents (T046-00219).
The available records do not provide a hash or signature validation result for pfupdater.exe; they identify its path and process activity (T046-00098, T046-00103).
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish what content was transferred inside the HTTPS tunnels (T046-00101, T046-00157, T046-00177, T046-00182, T046-00192, T046-00219).
The evidence does not independently verify the updater binary's integrity or whether the update content was legitimate (T046-00098, T046-00103).
unrelated_findings: Separate review: DropboxUpdate.exe ran as SYSTEM, and the host queried x7k9m2.akamaized.net. Dropbox is not listed among approved software/services; these records do not establish an outbound connection to that hostname. This is outside the alerted PixelForge activity (T046-00119, T046-00120, T046-00124, T046-00126, T046-00127, T046-00128).

Separate review: DC-NWD-01 recorded sam.okafor authentication activity with WS-LMARTINS-01 as the workstation, followed by a network logon for sam.okafor on WS-SOKAFOR-01 from WS-LMARTINS-01. This is inconsistent with the stated remote-administration practice and is unrelated to the alerted HTTPS connections (T046-00023, T046-00024).

Separate review: FILE-NWD-01 resolved WS-LMARTINS-01 and then initiated an RPC connection to that workstation on port 135. The records do not establish the purpose of this activity; it is unrelated to the alerted HTTPS connections (T046-00063, T046-00064, T046-00067, T046-00069).
